@echo off
echo Restoring NVIDIA CUDA and Video Rendering Support...
Reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\nvuvm" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "3" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\nvlddmkm" /v "DisableCudaContextPreemption" /f >nul 2>&1
echo NVIDIA CUDA restored. Restart your PC.
pause
